name: Turbine Trip At Power
description: The main turbine trips from full load. Steam dump to the condenser opens, secondary pressure rises, and the reactor trips on the anticipatory turbine-trip signal at high power.
briefing: The turbine trips at t+30 s. Confirm steam dump operation, the anticipatory reactor trip, and stabilise on decay heat with the condenser as the heat sink.
learning_objectives: Turbine/reactor coupling and the anticipatory reactor trip
Steam dump (condenser bypass) as an alternative heat sink
Secondary pressure response to a sudden loss of steam load
